Pharmacokinetics Misoprostol is reported to be rapidly absorbed and metabolised to its active form (misoprostol acid; SC- 30695) after oral doses; peak plasma concentrations of misoprostol acid occur after about 15 to 30 minutes. Food reduces the rate but not the extent of absorption. Misoprostol acid is further metabolised by oxidation in a number of body organs and is excreted mainly in the urine. The plasma elimination half-life is reported to be between 20 and 40 minutes. Misoprostol acid is dis- tributed into breast milk. ◊ References. 1. Schoenhard G, et al.
